historical_record.description: The site then held a 32-space parking lot and the facade of an industrial building at the 19th Street frontage.
The City Planning Commission upheld the preliminary negative declaration for proposed new construction of five buildings containing a total of 43 dwelling units, 5-0.
The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization to develop an up to 43-unit residential planned unit development, 5-0.
